notes: All figures are measured on this machine by the commands in method.md; nothing here is an estimate.
The machine was otherwise idle but a desktop GUI session was running; wall-clock launch figures include process start-up.
Live-path figures come from dalnok-cli bench, which pumps the real render path without a device.

appSnapshots.note: Wall time from process start to exit, including NSApplication launch, project load, window construction, drawing and PNG encoding.

build.note: Clean figures use a fresh scratch directory to avoid measuring a warm cache.

tests.selfTestNote: Self-test check count from CURRENT_STATE.md (Graphite 497 / Warm Analog 481 at 48 kHz); not re-run in this audit.

notMeasured: Timeline scroll and zoom frame time in a real window (no instrumented harness; requires a UI session).
Cold vs warm app launch without snapshot overhead.
Plug-in discovery and instantiation time on the installed library (plugins vary by machine).
Foreign project import time (Logic/Ableton/REAPER) beyond the reported 1.7 s for a 334-clip Ableton set in CURRENT_STATE.
RSS under a multi-hour session (no soak test).
Denormal and SIMD deltas (hypotheses in A-12 and A-13, not measured).
Out-of-process hosting overhead (A-01 is a design, not a measurement).

wave2.note: Parameter-read and combined measurements exclude AppKit refresh and rendering. The audit-scale run after a full structural undo history measured 0.038 ms gain p50 as old snapshots were evicted; model read 48.009 ms, structural edit 0.507 ms, undo 0.000 ms rounded. The earlier matching before audit-bench model read was 15.629 ms; later model-read timing was 42.564 ms, indicating noisy conditions.

appKit.notes: Synthetic AppKit drag events are dispatched in a tight burst; parameter refreshes are separately forced after engine edits. Refresh time includes synchronous UI callbacks. Deferred AppKit drawing/compositing, normal display pacing and full frame latency are not measured. A gain change and at least 100 model revisions were asserted. Both releases were built and run outside the sandbox using the same generated fixture.

finalVerification.note: audit-scale gain edits evict structural snapshots already in the 500-step history; do not compare directly with audit-bench compact-only history.

a04Incremental.note: Compile-only figures come from a temporary timer around compile() in commit(), removed after measuring. Structural edit includes the whole-model undo copy (about 0.06 ms).

a05PerTrackRefresh.fixture: generated, 16 tracks x 256 clips, 48000 Hz, Graphite, mixer visible
a05PerTrackRefresh.note: Structural refresh is a one-clip nudge followed by the full refresh callback; the all-tracks series uses forceRefresh in the same binary (the pre-A-05 behavior). 'Before' parameter figures are this branch before the mixer parameter path. Deferred drawing/compositing excluded.

a01Isolation.what: live block cost with the test gain VST3, in-process vs isolated (dalnok-plughost)
a01Isolation.note: One plug-in, one track, 48 kHz. The isolated cost is about one wake/wait round trip and is nearly independent of block size.

a01Stage2.what: A-01 stage 2 before/after (2026-11-19), same machine and harnesses
a01Stage2.overheadNote: Two runs each. The shared deadline and workgroup hand-off add no measurable per-block cost (within run-to-run spread).

a03Structural.note: History keeps clip deltas below the top step. An edit still copies the model transiently for rollback.

uiDrawing.fixture: generated, 16 tracks x 256 clips, mixer visible
uiDrawing.method: the same refresh cases followed by NSWindow.displayIfNeeded and CATransaction.flush (layer-backed views draw during the commit); window-server compositing excluded; 30 warmups, 100 samples
uiDrawing.structuralCommitAfter: layer commit about 20 ms, of which the timeline's own draw 5.4 ms (one lane); the rest is not attributed yet
uiDrawing.partialRedrawCheck: 10 of 10 one-lane redraws per theme differ from a fresh full draw by no more bytes than a full redraw does (1,397 Graphite / 1,275 Warm Analog of about 2.7 M)
